exposure: TGCS-TEN Groups Classification System categories of pregnancy
outcome: CS rates in different categories of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 4443 deliveries that occurred over a one-year duration in a tertiary care hospital in North India.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 44.58%, with Group 5 (women with a single previous CS) contributing the most (34.1%) and Group 1 contributing the second most (25.99%) to the total CS rate.
mod_finding: The study found that Group 5 (women with a single previous CS) and Group 1 were the largest contributors to the overall caesarean section rate, highlighting them as key targets for interventions aimed at reducing CS rates.
cross-section timing: Data collected over a one-year period
